opportunities.title: Research Project Grants (Detailed Applications)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations. Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. Two-stage process; the outline stage is paused, but invited applicants may submit Detailed Applications by 1 September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subjects except medical/clinical research, policy-driven research, and research with immediate commercial application

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum of £10,000 and a maximum of £150,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who coordinates the visit; some specialist arts institutions permitted. Visitor is an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills/knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research, with priority to new or recent collaborations. Visits of 3 to 12 months.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disability in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration, resident in the UK, permanent member of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research. Tenable 3 to 24 months. Applications materials available on the page in September 2026.
discipline_tags: Any discipline except studies of disease/illness/disability in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university or eligible Independent Research Organisation, resident in the UK, with an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication. Tenable 3 to 24 months. Application materials available on the page during September 2026.
discipline_tags: All subject areas except studies of disease/illness/disability in humans and animals and research intended to inform clinical practice

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards (Centenary Research Leadership Awards)

amount.raw: The awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at UK universities with research degree awarding powers; at least two years' experience post-PhD, holding a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent, or nominated by a UK university that undertakes to offer a contract.
opportunities.summary: For talented early career scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, developing research leadership. Grants of 4 to 5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
discipline_tags: Any research area except studies of disease/illness/disability, policy-driven research, advocacy, immediate commercial application, and database-assembly focus

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres (Centenary Research Centres)

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; may be single university or collaboration. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Centres may be single or multi-institution, run up to 10 years. The Centenary Research Centre round expected to open February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.
discipline_tags: Any topic in the Trust's remit; blue-skies, transformative and multidisciplinary research
